lines.beaver: 오늘은 삼계탕이랑 생선전 만들자. 재료 다 샀어?
lines.beaver_en: Let's make samgyetang and fish pancakes today. Did you buy everything?
lines.beaver_roman: oneureun samgyetangirang saengseonjeon mandeulja. jaeryo da sasseo?
lines.learner: 응, 닭이랑 인삼, 쌀 샀어. 생선도 신선해.
lines.en: Yes, I bought chicken, ginseng, and rice. The fish is fresh too.
lines.roman: eung, dalgirang insam, ssal sasseo. saengseondo sinseonhae.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 쌀은 먼저 물에 씻어 둬.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Wash the rice in water first.
lines.beaver_roman: joa. ssareun meonjeo mure ssiseo dwo.
lines.en: Do I have to put the rice inside the chicken?

lines.beaver: 응, 쌀이랑 인삼을 닭 안에 넣어.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, put the rice and ginseng inside the chicken.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, ssarirang insameul dak ane neoeo.
lines.en: Then do I put it in the pot and boil it?

lines.beaver_en: Right. When the water boils, turn down the heat.
lines.learner: 얼마나 끓여야 돼? 닭이 다 익어야 되지?
lines.en: How long should I boil it? The chicken has to be fully cooked, right?
lines.roman: eolmana kkeuryeoya dwae? dalgi da igeoya doeji?

lines.beaver: 한 시간쯤. 김이 오르면 뚜껑 조심해.
lines.beaver_en: About an hour. Be careful with the lid when steam rises.
lines.beaver_roman: han siganjjeum. gimi oreumyeon ttukkeong josimhae.
lines.learner: 알았어. 생선은 어떻게 해? 썰어야 돼?
lines.en: Okay. What about the fish? Do I have to slice it?
lines.roman: arasseo. saengseoneun eotteoke hae? sseoreoya dwae?

lines.learner: 밀가루도 필요해? 달걀은 몇 개 넣어?
lines.en: Do we need flour too? How many eggs do I add?
lines.roman: milgarudo piryohae? dalgyareun myeot gae neoeo?

lines.beaver: 밀가루 조금, 달걀은 서너 개면 돼.
lines.beaver_en: A little flour, and three or four eggs is enough.
lines.beaver_roman: milgaru jogeum, dalgyareun seoneo gaemyeon dwae.
lines.en: Do I have to mix the flour and eggs?

lines.beaver: 아니, 생선에 밀가루 먼저, 그다음 달걀이야.
lines.beaver_en: No, flour on the fish first, then the egg.
lines.beaver_roman: ani, saengseone milgaru meonjeo, geudaeum dalgyariya.
lines.en: Then when should I heat the frying pan?

lines.beaver: 지금 데워. 기름 넣고 생선을 구워.
lines.beaver_en: Heat it now. Add oil and fry the fish.
lines.beaver_roman: jigeum dewo. gireum neoko saengseoneul guwo.
lines.learner: 생선은 안 쪄도 돼? 간장도 필요해?
lines.en: I don't need to steam the fish? Do we need soy sauce?
lines.roman: saengseoneun an jjyeodo dwae? ganjangdo piryohae?

lines.beaver: 응, 굽기만 해. 간장은 찍어 먹을 때 써.
lines.beaver_en: Right, just fry it. Use soy sauce for dipping.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, gupgiman hae. ganjangeun jjigeo meogeul ttae sseo.
lines.learner: 고마워. 다 익으면 국물 떠서 같이 먹자!
lines.en: Thanks. When it's done, let's scoop the soup and eat together!
lines.roman: gomawo. da igeumyeon gungmul tteoseo gachi meokja!
